title: My Brother Forged A Dissolution And Sold Our $520K Collection. So I Dressed Him In Cranked Up Lies
description: After my brother forged a dissolution to steal our $520K museum deal, I uncovered our original partnership contract hidden inside a phonograph horn. Now he polishes brass in a 'Cranked Up Lies' shirt at my shop, Cylinder of Deceit Phonographs, while every restoration tag prints the fraud docket number. #FamilyBetrayal #ProRevenge #CylinderOfDeceit
thumb_text: BROTHER FORGED DISSOLUTION, NOW POLISHES BRASS IN CRANKED UP LIES
pinned_comment: If your own brother forged a dissolution to steal a $520K museum deal and left you with a $3,900 check, what would you have done the moment you found the original contract hidden in a phonograph horn? Share your story in the comments.
